statement.p: Find 6 + 17 + 28 + 39+ \cdots + 3823 using a technique from this section.

solution.p: 666246\text{.} If we take a_0 = 6\text{,} the terms of the sum are an arithmetic sequence with closed formula a_n = 6+11n\text{.} Then 3823 = a_{347}\text{,} for a total of 348 terms in the sum. Reverse and add to get 348 identical 3829 terms, which is twice the total we seek. 3829\cdot 348/2 = 666246.
